diagnosis.original_evidence: Source at the inherited R84 world geometry state used float center[3] = .5f*(eyeOffset[0]+eyeOffset[1]) and rebuilt independent relative arrays for full-world and affine paths.
diagnosis.root_cause: Two individually finite XR eye translations can overflow their intermediate float sum; even less extreme wide eye origins risk cancellation or bilateral disagreement when calculations are duplicated.
source_trace: OpenXR stereo.eyeOffset enters R84 per-frame XYZRHW world geometry state snapshot.
One newly validated two-eye headRelativeEyes array now feeds the actual full-world R29 matrix constructor and affine parallax localX/localY paths.
R33 physical GPU remains the original draw owner; source test and same-SHA Windows CI exercise production compiled dependency and native C++ fallback without claiming actual HMD acceptance.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Both stereo eyes receive symmetric IPD-relative positions from one atomic validated output; do not publish one eye if the other origin is NaN/Inf.
alternatives_rejected: Do not remove dense-scene objects, disable alpha effects, globally flatten world particles or change HMD projection/world scale to conceal failure; leave C993/CABE and existing world owners unchanged.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R84 actual C++ source replaced overflowing midpoint, both per-eye uses and fallback duplication with the preexisting stable BuildHeadRelativeEyeOffsets numerical owner.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extended native C++ zero-centered, wide-origin and invalid-eye preservation regression plus structural world-affine source assertion; mandatory CI pending.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: Quest3/VDXR was not connected and no measured FPS or binocular optical gameplay result is claimed.
